topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can hardly believe it, the randomness of it all just blows my mind. We've been talking for months, shared so much, laughed over the same stupid jokes, and now this? I keep going over the conversation where I found out. It was so casual, almost like he was shrugging off a big deal. Just another coincidence, right? But it's not, not to me. Now, I can't stop thinking about what this means. Could we actually meet? What would that even be like? I've never thought about it before, not really. Everything has changed, and I feel like I'm losing control of this perfect little bubble we've created. I can't sleep, can't focus. I keep checking my phone, even though I know he hasn't said anything new. What do I do now?
